text:
elaine: Starting the migration for orders.shard_swap on prod in the maintenance slot at 03:30 UTC. Deploybot will try to claim the DB lock in ~10m. tagging release-eng for visibility.

deploybot: Migration scheduled (id: orders_shard_swap_v3) for 2026-03-21T03:30:00Z. Will attempt to acquire lock `/db/migrations/orders_shard_swap`. Reply with `confirm` to proceed or `abort` to cancel.

dmitri: confirm — I'll own the lock and watch replica lag. Abort if lag > 15s or if lock contention persists > 60s.

ash: Putting a temporary pin on api-service to avoid new deployments during the change window: api-service -> v2.14.3+db-compat. @mike please ack so ops-config picks it up.

mike: ack. Pin pushed to config-store, propagation started :white_check_mark:

elaine: Backfill plan: incremental backfill at 500 rows/s. If p99 write latency > 500ms we throttle to 250. Metrics dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/ordermig

sara: Canary target tenant_id=42 added. Will monitor correctness and error rates for 2 minutes before broad rollout.

deploybot: Lock acquired by @dmitri. Step 1/4 starting: apply DDL.
```
ALTER TABLE orders_shard ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS new_bucket int DEFAULT 0;
```

dmitri: DDL applied. No live locks seen beyond the lock we expected. Step 2 will start backfill (dry-run mode for first 1k rows).

deploybot: Step 1 complete. Step 2/4: backfill dry-run in canary tenant. Showing sample rows processed: 1024 rows (duration 18s).

elaine: Hold for 30s — I see a transient lock on payments_read in region eu-west-1. If it doesn't clear, we'll delay full backfill 5m and re-evaluate.

mike: noted. If we need a rollback plan: 1) stop backfill, 2) revert schema toggle via feature-flag, 3) remove pin only after stable. Iterate runbook: #db-rollbacks v2.

dmitri: payments_read lock cleared after 12s. Proceeding with throttled backfill at 500 r/s.

deploybot: Step 3/4: progressive shard swap running. Progress: 8/12 shards swapped. ETA ~6m.

release-eng: Please add a short blurb to release notes: "DB: Shard swap for orders — no downtime expected; pinned API during window." I'll draft.

deploybot: Final step complete. Step 4/4: post-migration checks passed (replica lag < 5s, error rate unchanged). Migration job status: SUCCESS.

elaine: Great work — remove pin in 15m if metrics stay green. @sara please add canary observations to the release note.

sara: will add: saw a single 502 during the canary, traced to a retry edge-case, fixed by increasing client timeout. Adding note to release docs.

mike: I'll keep the pin for 15m then unpin. Leaving monitoring on alert policy: orders.high-latency.

dmitri: Lock released. Leaving a short postmortem in #postmortems later today.

elaine: Thanks team :tada:
